name: Knock

evidence.multichannel: F02: cross-channel orchestration across email, in-app, SMS, push, chat and webhooks
evidence.newsletter: F02: newsletters and one-time marketing campaigns through broadcasts

line: Coordinate email campaigns and triggered messages across in-app, SMS and push.

subs.math: 4,000 email messages fit inside Free's 10,000-message platform allowance. The external email sender and its fee are extra.
20,000 email messages fit inside Starter's 50,000-message platform allowance. The $250 covers Knock only; the external sender is billed separately.
40,000 email messages fit inside Starter's 50,000-message platform allowance. The $250 covers Knock only; the external sender is billed separately.
$250 plus 150,000 messages at $0.005 each = $1,000 Knock fee. The external sender is billed separately, and Enterprise may be quoted differently.

appmail.math: 3,000 successful email messages fit inside Free's 10,000-message platform allowance. The sender fee is extra.
10,000 successful email messages use all of Free's platform allowance. The sender fee is extra.
50,000 successful email messages use all of Starter's platform allowance. The sender fee is extra.
$250 plus 50,000 messages at $0.005 each = $500 Knock fee. The external sender is billed separately, and Enterprise may be quoted differently.
